mentions.name: Infrastry
mentions.description: This app provides a hands-off approach to deploying all kinds of (web) apps: you paste in a repo and it determines what type of software it is, how it should run, what should be configured, then provisions it to the internet and monitors it over time. The control plane is written in Elixir, using Jido & Oban to power the tools given to an agent that gets apps deployed. It currently uses Kubernetes for infrastructure, with the app => spec => build => deploy layers kept provider-agnostic so providers and methodologies can be swapped out later.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Infrastry, a completely hands-off approach to deploying all kinds of (web) apps. You paste in a repo and Infrastry takes it from there, determining what type of software it is, how it should run, what should be configured, and then provisions to the internet and monitors it over time.
